biography:
Wenfang Tang is a Presidential Chair Professor in the School of Humanities and Social Science at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, focusing his research on public opinion, mass politics, and political culture in contemporary China.

Professor Tang is the author of 9 books and monographs and several dozens of journal articles. His book, Populist Authoritarianism: Chinese Political Culture and Regime Sustainability (Oxford University Press, 2016), received the CHOICE Outstanding Academic Title award, and his latest monograph, Proud and Angry: Political Culture in Post-British Hong Kong, was published by Oxford University Press in 2026. His academic articles have appeared in leading journals such as the American Journal of Political Science, Political Research Quarterly, Political Communication, Journal of Contemporary China, and The China Quarterly.

Professor Tang currently serves as the Field Chief Editor of Frontiers in Political Science. He also served as a member of the Editorial Board of Political Psychology, and the Executive Committee of the Research Committee on Comparative Public Opinion of the International Political Science Association (IPSA).
